answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a grey-box framework that generates high quality textual adversarial examples while simultaneously trains an improved sentiment classifier... The generator G can be implemented as an autoencoder or a paraphrase generator... In this paper, we implement G as an auto-encoder...

answer_2.quote: We use the standard classification accuracy (ACC) of the target classifier (C) to measure the attacking performance of adversarial examples. ... To assess the textual and semantic similarity between the original and corresponding adversarial examples, we compute BLEU and USE. ... To measure the readability of generated adversarial examples, we use the acceptability score (ACPT).

answer_4.quote: We recruit two annotators internally to annotate a small sample of adversarial examples... We conduct a crowdsourcing experiment on Appen. We ask crowdworkers the following questions: 1. Is snippet B a good paraphrase of snippet A? ... 2. How natural does the text read? ... 3. What is the sentiment of the text?
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer three questions: (1) paraphrase quality (good, somewhat, no); (2) naturalness of the text (very unnatural, somewhat natural, natural); (3) sentiment polarity (positive, negative, cannot tell).
